title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Butler University
description: Ten under-21 food runs spanning Butler’s campus, nearby north-side corridors, and farther Indianapolis options with current official late-hour evidence.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Pizza ATM
cards.subtitle: Residential College, Butler University
cards.notes: Head to Midtown Provisions for an automated hot-food option when staffed campus counters have already closed.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock automated food stop inside Butler’s Residential College.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that the Pizza ATM in Midtown Provisions operates 24/7 and sells house-made pizzas, pretzel bites, and cookies.
cards.access_notes: The Pizza ATM operates 24/7; building access or academic-break conditions may affect availability.

cards.title: Order Late-Night Bites at Midtown
cards.subtitle: Residential College, Butler University
cards.notes: Order through Boost before midnight on a weekday; the late menu is separate from Midtown’s regular service.
cards.short_summary: Butler’s staffed weekday late-food counter runs through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Midtown Provisions’ Late-Night Bites service from 8:00 PM to midnight Monday through Friday, ordered through the Boost app.
cards.access_notes: Late-Night Bites runs Monday–Friday, 8:00 PM–midnight, and requires ordering through the Boost app.

cards.title: Catch A-Town Market Before Ten
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Atherton Union
cards.notes: Stop before the posted 10:00 PM weekday or Sunday close for made-to-order food, snacks, or microwaveable options.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus market that remains open later than Butler’s main dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists A-Town Market in Atherton Union as open until 10:00 PM Monday through Friday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 9:00 AM–10:00 PM Monday–Friday and 10:00 AM–10:00 PM Sunday; Saturday closes at 4:00 PM.

cards.entity_name: Pizza King | Meridian Kessler | Broad Ripple
cards.title: Make a Broad Ripple Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 5380 N College Avenue
cards.notes: Use this north-side stop for a counter-service pizza run, noting the slightly later Friday and Saturday close.
cards.short_summary: A named Broad Ripple pizza shop serving until nearly midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza King’s official Broad Ripple page lists an 11:00 PM close Sunday through Thursday and an 11:45 PM close Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11:45 PM Friday–Saturday, according to the restaurant’s official page.

cards.title: Use the All-Night Keystone Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 5509 N Keystone Avenue
cards.notes: Check the location page before leaving and confirm whether counter, pickup, or drive-through service fits your trip.
cards.short_summary: A north-side fast-food location whose official schedule spans the full day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-through hours from 4:00 AM to 3:59 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are listed as 4:00 AM–3:59 AM daily, effectively continuous service.

cards.title: Head South for a 3 A.M. Wendy’s
cards.subtitle: 2245 N Meridian Street
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to verify same-night service, especially if you need an option south of campus.
cards.short_summary: A Meridian Street fast-food run with service listed into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Indianapolis location listing identifies the 2245 N Meridian Street restaurant and lists it as open until 3:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official Wendy’s Indianapolis listing shows this location open until 3:00 AM; verify the available service channel before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 6165 N Keystone Avenue
cards.title: Try the 24-Hour Keystone Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 6165 N Keystone Avenue
cards.notes: Confirm the ordering channel before traveling; the official page currently shows continuous dine-in and drive-through hours.
cards.short_summary: A north-side Taco Bell officially displaying round-the-clock hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 6165 N Keystone Avenue lists both drive-through and dine-in hours as midnight to midnight every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Indianapolis, IN – 6165 N Keystone Ave.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists drive-through and dine-in service as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM daily; reconfirm before departure.

cards.title: Use the Late Dine-In on 38th Street
cards.subtitle: 2809 E 38th Street
cards.notes: Choose this location when indoor service matters; its posted dine-in close extends beyond many nearby restaurant counters.
cards.short_summary: An east-side Taco Bell with indoor service listed until 2:00 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-through service until 4:00 AM daily and dine-in service until 2:00 AM at 2809 E 38th Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Indianapolis, IN – 2809 East 38th Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is posted until 4:00 AM daily; the official page displays dine-in hours of 10:00 AM–2:00 AM.

cards.title: Take the Michigan Road Diner Route
cards.subtitle: 8640 Michigan Road
cards.notes: Save this longer northwestern run for nights when a seated diner-style menu matters more than staying close to campus.
cards.short_summary: A diner-style option serving until 2:00 AM on three nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak ’n Shake’s official location page lists midnight closing Monday through Thursday and 2:00 AM closing Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday–Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday–Sunday, according to the official location page.

cards.title: Pair Downtown Plans With Steak ’n Shake
